list.label: Points of sale, in storefront order

arrange.title: Arranging — no change | Arranging — {count} change | Arranging — {count} changes
arrange.hint: Move counters with the arrows, then save once.

states.noResults: No point of sale matches these filters.

panel.title: Point of sale
panel.description: View and manage this point of sale.
panel.notFound: This point of sale could not be found. It may have been deleted.
panel.deleteConfirmDescription: Only a point of sale that no customer, address or order refers to can be deleted. Otherwise, deactivate it: it leaves the storefront and the history stays readable.

form.libelleHint: What customers read. Two open counters in the same city cannot share a name.
form.cleHint: The name orders and customer profiles keep. It follows the counter name and can never be changed afterwards.
form.cleLocked: The key does not change: orders already carry it. To rename this counter, create a new one and deactivate this one.
form.repereHint: What a customer looks for to find the door, not a street number.
form.reperePlaceholder: e.g. Rue Drouot, next to the Pharmacie des hôpitaux
form.telephonesHint: The storefront and the shop assistant show these numbers in this order, the first one first. Cameroonian numbers, landline or mobile; WhatsApp only opens on a mobile.
form.telephoneMoved: The number is now in position {position} of {total}.
form.carteHint: In Google Maps, open the counter, tap “Share” then “Copy link”.
form.coordinatesHint: GPS coordinates, to place the counter on a map: in Google Maps, long-press the counter's entrance and copy the coordinates shown. Pasted into either field, they fill both.

errors.telephone: Enter a Cameroonian number, landline or mobile, for example 695 54 90 58.
errors.whatsapp: WhatsApp only opens on a mobile (+237 6XX XX XX XX): turn WhatsApp off for a landline.
errors.duplicateTelephone: This number is already higher up in the list.
errors.carte: Paste a Google Maps link over https, for example https://maps.app.goo.gl/… (the “Share” button in Google Maps).
errors.coordinate: Enter decimal degrees, for example 4.051056: latitude between -90 and 90, longitude between -180 and 180.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.refusedDescription: Deactivate it instead: it leaves the storefront and the history stays readable.

toast.orderFailed: Order not saved — put back as it was.

drawer.leaveDescription: {count} change will be lost. | {count} changes will be lost.
drawer.notSavedAt: Not saved yet · will join the storefront at position {position}
